item.title: Actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies aged 86
item.body: Sir Patrick Stewart died at his home in Los Angeles following a short period with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy Body Dementia, according to reports. He was 86.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🎭 Actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies aged 86

Sir Patrick Stewart died at his home in Los Angeles following a short period with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy Body Dementia, according to reports. He was 86.

Source: Evening Standard | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 29 October, 20:20
